title: Cost-Related Barriers to Care and Medications Among US Stroke Survivors, 2019–2025: analysis code, aggregate results and manuscript
description: Reproducible analysis code, aggregate results, tables, figures and working manuscript for a repeated cross-sectional analysis of the 2019–2025 National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) examining cost-related healthcare affordability barriers among US adults reporting prior stroke. Analyses use annual and 2020 partial-sample weights, all ten NCHS income imputations, survey-weighted modified Poisson models and standardized annual prevalence. Raw NHIS public-use microdata are not included; acquisition scripts download them from NCHS and verify file hashes.
